verdict.rationale: The RTX 5080 is a GPU, and user-configured autonomous background automations are a software or agent capability, not a fair axis for graphics hardware. Nothing in the pack shows the product shipping such a feature: G-Assist is described only as an assistant that helps tune and control the system, and RTX Video's automatic sharpening is a fixed image-processing behavior, not user-defined automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
